reason: Two errors: (1) Question cites 'Section 20 of the IRR' for service categories, but Section 20 is about the architect's seal; categories are in Section 3. (2) Option c has a malformed data structure — it lacks an 'id' field and incorrectly embeds 'correct_option_id': 'b' as an internal field.

proposed.text: According to Section 3 of RA 9266, how many primary service categories does architectural practice encompass?

rationale.a: Five categories would omit significant service domains recognized in the statute.
rationale.b: Eight categories falls short of the full enumeration.
rationale.d: Twelve exceeds the statutory enumeration; there are exactly ten primary categories.
rationale.correct: RA 9266 Section 3 enumerates ten (10) distinct service areas (labeled a through j). The IRR identifies 9 primary categories (a through i) with a tenth catch-all provision (j) for other works requiring architectural competence.
rationale.takeaway: These ten categories define the boundaries of architectural scope. Note that Section 3 defines scope, NOT Section 20 (which is about the architect's seal).
